Gets the Web Probe metrics trend on a device for an application
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/apps/:appid/web-probes/:probeid

Gets the Web Probe metrics trend on a device for an application. For Web Probes, you can access Page Fetch Time, Server Response Time, DNS Time, or Availability. If not specified, it defaults to Page Fetch Time (PFT). If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

appid
integer
REQUIRED

The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

Example: 12
probeid
integer
REQUIRED

The probe ID.

Example: 12
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
metric
string

The name of the metric (for example, PFT).

unit
string

The unit of the metric.

datapoints
object[]
]
